stages.text: Start with Gone Fishing, then finish Chapters 1 and 2. Grab easy free-roam trophies on the way (stunts, vehicles, WAiNK It) but do not grind yet.
stages.title: Play the story, chapters 1–2

stages.text: Finish Chapters 3 and 4 and every named mission trophy (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory). Do the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy while your partner is with you.
stages.title: Chapters 3–4 and named missions

stages.text: Between chapters, answer stranger markers and finish full strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret's hunt, and 8 strands total for Strangers & Freaks.
stages.title: Stranger strands across Leonida

stages.text: Keep a manual save before the final mission, then complete it for the gold trophy. After the finale, free roam opens up for the cleanup.
stages.title: The finale — save first

stages.text: 250 stunts, 9 activity types, 42 gold Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, 50 challenges, Combat Focus x5, bowling at Kolt & Associates, and the melee drive-by.
stages.title: Activities grind

stages.text: 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK It locations, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas of Leonida, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.text: Bank vaults x5, armored truck, one illegal operation per gang (9), jewelry store undetected, the VCIA departure, Ocean Beach cocktail, showroom smash, plus laundering $250,000 and spending $100,000.
stages.title: Money, robberies and the odd ones

stages.text: Mop up the last checklist items until the in-game completion reads 100% for A Long Road (gold). The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops automatically last.
stages.title: 100% completion and the platinum

title: Roadmap to the platinum — Vice City Trophy Atlas
